description: The members of a stock index (S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, Russell 2000, S&P 400, MSCI EAFE) with their weights, read from the N-PORT of an ETF that tracks it, with the report date, the number of members and how concentrated the top ten are.

index.description: An index by name ("S&P 500", "Nasdaq 100", "Russell 2000", "S&P 400", "MSCI EAFE"), or the ticker of an ETF that tracks the index you want (VOO, IWM).

limit.description: Most members to list, by weight; default 50.

name: index_constituents

outputSchema.description: rows are the index's members by weight (weights as fractions adding to 1).

title: Index constituents
